name: Adjustable-core inductor
summary: An adjustable-core inductor varies its documented inductive characteristic through a magnetic adjustment.
description: An adjustable-core inductor varies its documented inductive characteristic through a magnetic adjustment. Its permissible range and adjustment method require equipment information.
readingNotes: Separate the adjustment mechanism from the electrical winding terminals.
